scripts.seed: npm run seed:deps && npm --prefix scripts/seed-devnet run seed --
scripts.seed:verify: npm run seed:deps && npm --prefix scripts/seed-devnet run verify --
scripts.seed:validator: npm run seed:deps && npm --prefix scripts/seed-devnet run validator --
scripts.test:seed: npm run seed:deps && npm --prefix scripts/seed-devnet test
scripts.export-idl: for dir in frontend/src/lib/solana/idl-v2 backend/src/solana/idl; do cp target/idl/axel_v2.json "$dir/axel_v2.json" && sed 's|IDL can be found at `target/idl/axel_v2.json`.|IDL can be found at `axel_v2.json` next to this file.|' target/types/axel_v2.ts > "$dir/axel_v2.ts" || exit 1; done
